title: Deliver Iron Ore to Truningwell Ridge Steel Mill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Iron Ore** delivered to **Truningwell Ridge Steel Mill** (industry id 15, near tile 34,87).

A likely supplier is **Truningwell Ridge Iron Ore Mine** (industry id 9, near tile 40,105); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **410 units** within the horizon.

**Promise:** within the first 30 game-days, commit to a delivery quantity with `rh promise quantity=N` (the last promise before the deadline counts; max 1,100). You are paid for min(delivered, promised) and fined for any shortfall, so promise what you can really deliver: over- and under-promising both cost you.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
